title: Cloud credentials and fork bombs are contained
description:
As the maintainer, I want student code to see no AWS credentials and be unable to exhaust processes.

Feature: Credential and process containment
  Scenario: No credentials in the environment
    Given a program that prints its environment variables
    When the project is run
    Then no AWS or container-credential variables appear
  Scenario: A fork bomb is contained
    Given a program that forks without limit
    When the project is run
    Then the run ends with a process limit error and the runner stays responsive

comments.author: home
comments.text: Specs pass; credentials and fork bombs contained (per-run uid, seccomp, cleanup).

right_now_summary: Tests confirm credentials stay hidden and fork bombs are contained while the runner remains responsive.
